name: check-variable-precision
hypothesis: Explicitly requiring check definition as `const checkCmd = '...'` and upgrading byte-diff from 'only trustworthy' to 'MUST-BE' with explicit prohibition of alternatives forces check precision and reuse, preventing check-definition drift that allows spurious passes on output-mismatch tasks.
prediction: Output-mismatch failures (6 cases) decrease as models create stricter byte-diff checks defined once and reused throughout. Expected: 37–38/42 (2–3 additional passes), particularly bugfix-statemachine, feature-topwords, wiring-stats.
